papers.abstract_zh: 3D 高斯图的修剪对于降低其复杂性以实现高效存储、传输和下游处理至关重要。然而，大多数现有的修剪策略依赖于相机参数、渲染图像或依赖于视图的测量。这种依赖性成为新兴的与相机无关的交换设置中的一个障碍，在这种交换设置中，splats 直接作为基于点的表示（例如 .ply）进行共享。在本文中，我们提出了一种与相机无关的一次性训练后修剪方法，用于 3D 高斯图，该方法仅依赖于属性导出的邻域描述符。作为我们的主要贡献，我们引入了一个混合描述符框架，该框架直接从 splat 表示中捕获结构和外观一致性。基于这些描述符，我们将剪枝制定为统计证据估计问题，并引入了 Beta 证据模型，该模型通过概率置信度得分来量化每个图块的可靠性。   在 ISO/IEC MPEG 通用测试条件 (CTC) 定义的标准化测试序列上进行的实验表明，我们的方法在保持重建质量的同时实现了实质性的修剪，为现有的依赖于摄像机的修剪策略建立了实用且通用的替代方案。

papers.title: SmaAT-QMix-UNet: A Parameter-Efficient Vector-Quantized UNet for Precipitation Nowcasting
papers.abstract: Weather forecasting supports critical socioeconomic activities and complements environmental protection, yet operational Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) systems remain computationally intensive, thus being inefficient for certain applications. Meanwhile, recent advances in deep data-driven models have demonstrated promising results in nowcasting tasks. This paper presents SmaAT-QMix-UNet, an enhanced variant of SmaAT-UNet that introduces two key innovations: a vector quantization (VQ) bottleneck at the encoder-decoder bridge, and mixed kernel depth-wise convolutions (MixConv) replacing selected encoder and decoder blocks. These enhancements both reduce the model's size and improve its nowcasting performance. We train and evaluate SmaAT-QMix-UNet on a Dutch radar precipitation dataset (2016-2019), predicting precipitation 30 minutes ahead. Three configurations are benchmarked: using only VQ, only MixConv, and the full SmaAT-QMix-UNet. Grad-CAM saliency maps highlight the regions influencing each nowcast, while a UMAP embedding of the codewords illustrates how the VQ layer clusters encoder outputs. The source code for SmaAT-QMix-UNet is publicly available on GitHub \footnote{\href{https://github.com/nstavr04/MasterThesisSnellius}{https://github.com/nstavr04/MasterThesisSnellius}}.
papers.title_zh: SmaAT-QMix-UNet：用于降水临近预报的参数高效矢量量化 UNet
papers.abstract_zh: 天气预报支持关键的社会经济活动并补充环境保护，但可运行的数值天气预报（NWP）系统仍然需要大量计算，因此对于某些应用来说效率低下。与此同时，深度数据驱动模型的最新进展在临近预报任务中展现出了可喜的成果。本文介绍了 SmaAT-QMix-UNet，它是 SmaAT-UNet 的增强变体，它引入了两项关键创新：编码器-解码器桥上的矢量量化 (VQ) 瓶颈，以及取代选定编码器和解码器块的混合内核深度卷积 (MixConv)。这些增强功能既减小了模型的大小，又提高了其临近预报性能。我们在荷兰雷达降水数据集（2016-2019）上训练和评估 SmaAT-QMix-UNet，预测提前 30 分钟的降水。对三种配置进行了基准测试：仅使用 VQ、仅使用 MixConv 和完整的 SmaAT-QMix-UNet。 Grad-CAM 显着图突出显示了影响每个即时广播的区域，而码字的 UMAP 嵌入则说明了 VQ 层如何对编码器输出进行聚类。 SmaAT-QMix-UNet 的源代码可在 GitHub \footnote{\href{https://github.com/nstavr04/MasterThesisSnellius}{https://github.com/nstavr04/MasterThesisSnellius}} 上公开获取。

papers.title: LRC-WeatherNet: LiDAR, RADAR, and Camera Fusion Network for Real-time Weather-type Classification in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Autonomous vehicles face major perception and navigation challenges in adverse weather such as rain, fog, and snow, which degrade the performance of LiDAR, RADAR, and RGB camera sensors. While each sensor type offers unique strengths, such as RADAR robustness in poor visibility and LiDAR precision in clear conditions, they also suffer distinct limitations when exposed to environmental obstructions. This study proposes LRC-WeatherNet, a novel multi-sensor fusion framework that integrates LiDAR, RADAR, and camera data for real-time classification of weather conditions. By employing both early fusion using a unified Bird's Eye View representation and mid-level gated fusion of modality-specific feature maps, our approach adapts to the varying reliability of each sensor under changing weather. Evaluated on the extensive MSU-4S dataset covering nine weather types, LRC-WeatherNet achieves superior classification performance and computational efficiency, significantly outperforming unimodal baselines in adverse conditions. This work is the first to combine all three modalities for robust, real-time weather classification in autonomous driving. We release our trained models and source code in https://github.com/nouralhudaalbashir/LRC-WeatherNet.
papers.title_zh: LRC-WeatherNet：用于自动驾驶中实时天气类型分类的 LiDAR、RADAR 和摄像头融合网络
papers.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶汽车在雨、雾、雪等恶劣天气下面临着重大的感知和导航挑战，这会降低激光雷达、雷达和 RGB 摄像头传感器的性能。虽然每种传感器类型都具有独特的优势，例如雷达在能见度较差的情况下的鲁棒性和激光雷达在晴朗条件下的精度，但当暴露在环境障碍物中时，它们也会受到明显的限制。本研究提出了 LRC-WeatherNet，这是一种新颖的多传感器融合框架，集成了 LiDAR、RADAR 和摄像头数据，用于对天气状况进行实时分类。通过采用统一鸟瞰图表示的早期融合和特定模态特征图的中级门控融合，我们的方法适应了每个传感器在不断变化的天气下不同的可靠性。在涵盖九种天气类型的广泛 MSU-4S 数据集上进行评估后，LRC-WeatherNet 实现了卓越的分类性能和计算效率，在不利条件下显着优于单峰基线。这项工作首次将所有三种模式结合起来，在自动驾驶中实现强大的实时天气分类。我们在 https://github.com/nouralhudaalbashir/LRC-WeatherNet 中发布了经过训练的模型和源代码。

papers.title: Manifold-Aware Exploration for Reinforcement Learning in Video Generation
papers.abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) methods for video generation like FlowGRPO remain far less reliable than their counterparts for language models and images. This gap arises because video generation has a complex solution space, and the ODE-to-SDE conversion used for exploration can inject excess noise, lowering rollout quality and making reward estimates less reliable, which destabilizes post-training alignment. To address this problem, we view the pre-trained model as defining a valid video data manifold and formulate the core problem as constraining exploration within the vicinity of this manifold, ensuring that rollout quality is preserved and reward estimates remain reliable. We propose SAGE-GRPO (Stable Alignment via Exploration), which applies constraints at both micro and macro levels. At the micro level, we derive a precise manifold-aware SDE with a logarithmic curvature correction and introduce a gradient norm equalizer to stabilize sampling and updates across timesteps. At the macro level, we use a dual trust region with a periodic moving anchor and stepwise constraints so that the trust region tracks checkpoints that are closer to the manifold and limits long-horizon drift. We evaluate SAGE-GRPO on HunyuanVideo1.5 using the original VideoAlign as the reward model and observe consistent gains over previous methods in VQ, MQ, TA, and visual metrics (CLIPScore, PickScore), demonstrating superior performance in both reward maximization and overall video quality. The code and visual gallery are available at https://dungeonmassster.github.io/SAGE-GRPO-Page/.
papers.title_zh: 视频生成中强化学习的流形感知探索
papers.abstract_zh: 用于视频生成的组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 方法（例如 FlowGRPO）仍然远不如语言模型和图像的对应方法可靠。出现这种差距的原因是视频生成具有复杂的解决方案空间，并且用于探索的 ODE 到 SDE 转换可能会注入过多的噪声，降低推出质量并使奖励估计不太可靠，从而破坏训练后对齐的稳定性。为了解决这个问题，我们将预训练模型视为定义有效的视频数据流形，并将核心问题表述为限制该流形附近的探索，确保保留推出质量并且奖励估计保持可靠。我们提出了 SAGE-GRPO（通过探索实现稳定对齐），它在微观和宏观层面都施加了约束。在微观层面，我们推导出具有对数曲率校正的精确流形感知 SDE，并引入梯度范数均衡器来稳定跨时间步长的采样和更新。在宏观层面，我们使用具有周期性移动锚和逐步约束的双重信任区域，以便信任区域跟踪更接近流形的检查点并限制长范围漂移。我们使用原始 VideoAlign 作为奖励模型在 HunyuanVideo1.5 上评估 SAGE-GRPO，并在 VQ、MQ、TA 和视觉指标（CLIPScore、PickScore）方面观察到与之前的方法相比一致的增益，在奖励最大化和整体视频质量方面表现出卓越的性能。代码和视觉库可在 https://dungeonmassster.github.io/SAGE-GRPO-Page/ 获取。

papers.title: SecureBreak -- A dataset towards safe and secure models
papers.abstract: Large language models are becoming pervasive core components in many real-world applications. As a consequence, security alignment represents a critical requirement for their safe deployment. Although previous related works focused primarily on model architectures and alignment methodologies, these approaches alone cannot ensure the complete elimination of harmful generations. This concern is reinforced by the growing body of scientific literature showing that attacks, such as jailbreaking and prompt injection, can bypass existing security alignment mechanisms. As a consequence, additional security strategies are needed both to provide qualitative feedback on the robustness of the obtained security alignment at the training stage, and to create an ``ultimate'' defense layer to block unsafe outputs possibly produced by deployed models. To provide a contribution in this scenario, this paper introduces SecureBreak, a safety-oriented dataset designed to support the development of AI-driven solutions for detecting harmful LLM outputs caused by residual weaknesses in security alignment. The dataset is highly reliable due to careful manual annotation, where labels are assigned conservatively to ensure safety. It performs well in detecting unsafe content across multiple risk categories. Tests with pre-trained LLMs show improved results after fine-tuning on SecureBreak. Overall, the dataset is useful both for post-generation safety filtering and for guiding further model alignment and security improvements.
papers.title_zh: SecureBreak——安全可靠模型的数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型正在成为许多现实应用程序中普遍存在的核心组件。因此，安全一致性是其安全部署的关键要求。尽管之前的相关工作主要集中在模型架构和对齐方法上，但仅靠这些方法并不能确保完全消除有害生成。越来越多的科学文献表明，越狱和即时注入等攻击可以绕过现有的安全调整机制，这进一步强化了这种担忧。因此，需要额外的安全策略，以便在训练阶段提供有关所获得的安全一致性的稳健性的定性反馈，并创建“最终”防御层以阻止部署模型可能产生的不安全输出。为了在这种情况下做出贡献，本文引入了 SecureBreak，这是一个面向安全的数据集，旨在支持人工智能驱动的解决方案的开发，以检测由安全对齐中的残余弱点引起的有害 LLM 输出。由于仔细的手动注释，数据集高度可靠，其中标签被保守地分配以确保安全。它在检测多个风险类别的不安全内容方面表现良好。对预先训练的法学硕士进行的测试表明，在 SecureBreak 上进行微调后，结果有所改善。总体而言，该数据集对于生成后安全过滤以及指导进一步的模型对齐和安全改进都很有用。

papers.title: CayleyPy-4: AI-Holography. Towards analogs of holographic string dualities for AI tasks
papers.abstract: This is the fourth paper in the CayleyPy project, which applies AI methods to the exploration of large graphs. In this work, we suggest the existence of a new discrete version of holographic string dualities for this setup, and discuss their relevance to AI systems and mathematics. Many modern AI tasks -- such as those addressed by GPT-style language models or RL systems -- can be viewed as direct analogues of predicting particle trajectories on graphs. We investigate this problem for a large family of Cayley graphs, for which we show that surprisingly it admits a dual description in terms of discrete strings. We hypothesize that such dualities may extend to a range of AI systems where they can lead to more efficient computational approaches. In particular, string holographic images of states are proposed as natural candidates for data embeddings, motivated by the "complexity = volume" principle in AdS/CFT.   For Cayley graphs of the symmetric group S_n, our results indicate that the corresponding dual objects are flat, planar polygons. The diameter of the graph is equal to the number of integer points inside the polygon scaled by n. Vertices of the graph can be mapped holographically to paths inside the polygon, and the usual graph distances correspond to the area under the paths, thus directly realising the "complexity = volume" paradigm. We also find evidence for continuous CFTs and dual strings in the large n limit. We confirm this picture and other aspects of the duality in a large initial set of examples. We also present new datasets (obtained by a combination of ML and conventional tools) which should be instrumental in establishing the duality for more general cases.
papers.title_zh: CayleyPy-4：人工智能全息术。面向人工智能任务的全息弦对偶性的模拟
papers.abstract_zh: 这是CayleyPy项目的第四篇论文，将AI方法应用于大图的探索。在这项工作中，我们建议这种设置存在一种新的离散版本的全息弦对偶性，并讨论它们与人工智能系统和数学的相关性。许多现代人工智能任务——比如那些由 GPT 风格的语言模型或强化学习系统解决的任务——可以被视为预测图上粒子轨迹的直接类似物。我们针对一大群凯莱图研究了这个问题，令人惊讶的是，它承认离散字符串的双重描述。我们假设这种二元性可能会扩展到一系列人工智能系统，从而产生更有效的计算方法。特别是，受 AdS/CFT 中“复杂性=体积”原则的启发，状态的弦全息图像被提议作为数据嵌入的自然候选者。   对于对称群 S_n 的凯莱图，我们的结果表明相应的对偶对象是平坦的平面多边形。图的直径等于多边形内部整数点数按 n 缩放。图的顶点可以全息映射到多边形内部的路径，通常的图距离对应于路径下的面积，从而直接实现“复杂度=体积”范式。我们还发现了大 n 极限下连续 CFT 和双串的证据。我们在大量初始示例中证实了这一图景和二元性的其他方面。我们还提出了新的数据集（通过机器学习和传统工具的组合获得），这应该有助于建立更一般情况的对偶性。

papers.title: SpecTM: Spectral Targeted Masking for Trustworthy Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Foundation models are now increasingly being developed for Earth observation (EO), yet they often rely on stochastic masking that do not explicitly enforce physics constraints; a critical trustworthiness limitation, in particular for predictive models that guide public health decisions. In this work, we propose SpecTM (Spectral Targeted Masking), a physics-informed masking design that encourages the reconstruction of targeted bands from cross-spectral context during pretraining. To achieve this, we developed an adaptable multi-task (band reconstruction, bio-optical index inference, and 8-day-ahead temporal prediction) self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that encodes spectrally intrinsic representations via joint optimization, and evaluated it on a downstream microcystin concentration regression model using NASA PACE hyperspectral imagery over Lake Erie. SpecTM achieves R^2 = 0.695 (current week) and R^2 = 0.620 (8-day-ahead) predictions surpassing all baseline models by (+34% (0.51 Ridge) and +99% (SVR 0.31)) respectively. Our ablation experiments show targeted masking improves predictions by +0.037 R^2 over random masking. Furthermore, it outperforms strong baselines with 2.2x superior label efficiency under extreme scarcity. SpecTM enables physics-informed representation learning across EO domains and improves the interpretability of foundation models.
papers.title_zh: SpecTM：用于值得信赖的基础模型的光谱定向掩蔽
papers.abstract_zh: 现在越来越多的基础模型被开发用于地球观测（EO），但它们通常依赖于不明确强制物理约束的随机掩蔽；一个关键的可信度限制，特别是对于指导公共卫生决策的预测模型而言。在这项工作中，我们提出了 SpecTM（光谱目标掩蔽），这是一种基于物理的掩蔽设计，鼓励在预训练期间从跨光谱上下文中重建目标波段。为了实现这一目标，我们开发了一种适应性强的多任务（谱带重建、生物光学指数推断和提前 8 天时间预测）自监督学习 (SSL) 框架，该框架通过联合优化对光谱内在表示进行编码，并使用伊利湖上空的 NASA PACE 高光谱图像在下游微囊藻毒素浓度回归模型上对其进行评估。 SpecTM 实现了 R^2 = 0.695（本周）和 R^2 = 0.620（提前 8 天）预测，分别超过所有基线模型（+34%（0.51 Ridge）和 +99%（SVR 0.31））。我们的消融实验表明，与随机掩蔽相比，定向掩蔽可将预测提高 +0.037 R^2。此外，在极度稀缺的情况下，它的标签效率比强基线高出 2.2 倍。 SpecTM 能够实现跨 EO 领域的基于物理的表示学习，并提高基础模型的可解释性。

papers.title: More Isn't Always Better: Balancing Decision Accuracy and Conformity Pressures in Multi-AI Advice
papers.abstract: Just as people improve decision-making by consulting diverse human advisors, they can now also consult with multiple AI systems. Prior work on group decision-making shows that advice aggregation creates pressure to conform, leading to overreliance. However, the conditions under which multi-AI consultation improves or undermines human decision-making remain unclear. We conducted experiments with three tasks in which participants received advice from panels of AIs. We varied panel size, within-panel consensus, and the human-likeness of presentation. Accuracy improved for small panels relative to a single AI; larger panels yielded no gains. The level of within-panel consensus affected participants' reliance on AI advice: High consensus fostered overreliance; a single dissent reduced pressure to conform; wide disagreement created confusion and undermined appropriate reliance. Human-like presentations increased perceived usefulness and agency in certain tasks, without raising conformity pressure. These findings yield design implications for presenting multi-AI advice that preserve accuracy while mitigating conformity.
papers.title_zh: 更多并不总是更好：平衡多人工智能建议中的决策准确性和一致性压力
papers.abstract_zh: 正如人们通过咨询不同的人类顾问来改善决策一样，他们现在也可以咨询多个人工智能系统。先前关于群体决策的研究表明，建议聚合会产生服从压力，导致过度依赖。然而，多人工智能协商在何种条件下改善或破坏人类决策仍不清楚。我们对三项任务进行了实验，参与者接受了人工智能小组的建议。我们改变了小组的大小、小组内的共识以及演示的人性化。相对于单个 AI，小面板的准确度有所提高；较大的面板没有产生任何收益。小组内共识的水平影响了参与者对人工智能建议的依赖：高度共识会导致过度依赖；单一的异议减少了服从的压力；广泛的分歧造成了混乱并破坏了适当的信任。类人的演示增加了某些任务中的感知有用性和代理性，而不会增加从众压力。这些发现为提出多人工智能建议提供了设计启示，这些建议可以在保持准确性的同时减少一致性。

papers.title: Tacit Knowledge Management with Generative AI: Proposal of the GenAI SECI Model
papers.abstract: The emergence of generative AI is bringing about a significant transformation in knowledge management. Generative AI has the potential to address the limitations of conventional knowledge management systems, and it is increasingly being deployed in real-world settings with promising results. Related research is also expanding rapidly. However, much of this work focuses on research and practice related to the management of explicit knowledge. While fragmentary efforts have been made regarding the management of tacit knowledge using generative AI, the modeling and systematization that handle both tacit and explicit knowledge in an integrated manner remain insufficient. In this paper, we propose the "GenAI SECI" model as an updated version of the knowledge creation process (SECI) model, redesigned to leverage the capabilities of generative AI. A defining feature of the "GenAI SECI" model is the introduction of "Digital Fragmented Knowledge", a new concept that integrates explicit and tacit knowledge within cyberspace. Furthermore, a concrete system architecture for the proposed model is presented, along with a comparison with prior research models that share a similar problem awareness and objectives.
papers.title_zh: 生成式人工智能的隐性知识管理：GenAI SECI 模型的提议
papers.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能的出现正在给知识管理带来重大变革。生成式人工智能有潜力解决传统知识管理系统的局限性，并且它越来越多地被部署在现实世界中，并取得了可喜的结果。相关研究也在迅速扩大。然而，这项工作的大部分重点是与显性知识管理相关的研究和实践。虽然在使用生成人工智能管理隐性知识方面已经做出了一些零碎的努力，但以综合方式处理隐性知识和显性知识的建模和系统化仍然不够。在本文中，我们提出“GenAI SECI”模型作为知识创建过程（SECI）模型的更新版本，经过重新设计以利用生成式人工智能的功能。 “GenAI SECI”模型的一个显着特征是引入了“数字碎片知识”，这是一个整合网络空间内显性知识和隐性知识的新概念。此外，还提出了所提出模型的具体系统架构，并与具有相似问题意识和目标的先前研究模型进行了比较。

papers.title: Evaluating the Reliability and Fidelity of Automated Judgment Systems of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: A Large Language Model (LLM) as judge evaluates the quality of victim Machine Learning (ML) models, specifically LLMs, by analyzing their outputs. An LLM as judge is the combination of one model and one specifically engineered judge prompt that contains the criteria for the analysis. The resulting automation of the analysis scales up the complex evaluation of the victim models' free-form text outputs by faster and more consistent judgments compared to human reviewers. Thus, quality and security assessments of LLMs can cover a wide range of the victim models' use cases. Being a comparably new technique, LLMs as judges lack a thorough investigation for their reliability and agreement to human judgment.   Our work evaluates the applicability of LLMs as automated quality assessors of victim LLMs. We test the efficacy of 37 differently sized conversational LLMs in combination with 5 different judge prompts, the concept of a second-level judge, and 5 models fine-tuned for the task as assessors. As assessment objective, we curate datasets for eight different categories of judgment tasks and the corresponding ground-truth labels based on human assessments. Our empirical results show a high correlation of LLMs as judges with human assessments, when combined with a suitable prompt, in particular for GPT-4o, several open-source models with $\geqslant$ 32B parameters, and a few smaller models like Qwen2.5 14B.
papers.title_zh: 评估大型语言模型自动判断系统的可靠性和保真度
papers.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 作为法官，通过分析受害者机器学习 (ML) 模型（特别是 LLM）的输出来评估其质量。作为法官的法学硕士是一种模型和一个专门设计的法官提示的组合，其中包含分析标准。与人类评审员相比，由此产生的分析自动化通过更快、更一致的判断，扩大了对受害者模型的自由格式文本输出的复杂评估。因此，法学硕士的质量和安全评估可以涵盖广泛的受害者模型的用例。作为一种相对较新的技术，法学硕士作为法官缺乏对其可靠性和与人类判断的一致性进行彻底的调查。   我们的工作评估了法学硕士作为受害法学硕士的自动质量评估员的适用性。我们测试了 37 个不同规模的会话式 LLM 与 5 个不同的法官提示、二级法官的概念以及 5 个针对评估员任务进行微调的模型的效果。作为评估目标，我们根据人类评估为八种不同类别的判断任务和相应的真实标签整理数据集。我们的实证结果表明，当与适当的提示相结合时，法学硕士作为法官与人类评估具有高度相关性，特别是对于 GPT-4o、几个具有 $\geqslant$ 32B 参数的开源模型以及一些较小的模型（如 Qwen2.5 14B）。
